- **Door 6 duplicate arrivals:** Thea Ramaswell is Quarrendon's Director of Yard Operations. On 20 Aug 2025, Dana posted in #north-team that Thea had reported duplicate arrivals on door 6 again during the morning shift. The same trailer showed up twice because the driver checked in at the kiosk and then dispatch added him by hand. The North cheat sheet also lists Thea as the account's main contact, and Dana Okafor owns the account on our side.
- **Name mix-up to avoid:** Marcus's Aug 2025 note about a door 6 problem is about Quarendon Freightways. That's a different company and not a customer, so I told him not to mix the two up in the handover.
